The '''Goratak system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Vensensor sector/Legends|Vensensor sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goratak III]].
